name: sandbox-docker
description: Containers on this machine's Docker (Docker Desktop, OrbStack, Colima, Podman's docker). Snapshots are images; idle machines are swept by capcomd.

image.description: The image agents boot from when no environment is built

agentMemoryMb.description: Memory per agent container; sets how many run at once

idleLifetimeSeconds.description: How long a container left behind lives before the sweep deletes it
